## 🔧 TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION STANDARDS

### Core Technology Stack
```yaml
Frontend Framework: Next.js 14 with TypeScript
Styling: Tailwind CSS with custom design system
State Management: Zustand + React Query
Authentication: Custom SSO with logai.ro
Database: Multi-provider (Firebase, PostgreSQL, MongoDB)
AI Integration: GPT-4o via Azure OpenAI
Payment Processing: Stripe + Romanian banking APIs
Blockchain: Custom CodaiChain protocol
DevOps: Docker + Kubernetes + GitHub Actions
Monitoring: Custom monitoring via admin.codai.ro
```

### Security Requirements
```yaml
Authentication: Multi-factor with biometric support
Encryption: End-to-end encryption for all data
Compliance: GDPR, PCI DSS, Romanian regulations
Vulnerability Scanning: Automated security audits
Access Control: Role-based with agent permissions
Data Privacy: User-controlled data sharing
Audit Trails: Complete action logging
Penetration Testing: Regular security assessments
```

### Performance Standards
```yaml
Page Load Times: < 3 seconds for all pages
API Response Times: < 500ms for all endpoints
Database Queries: < 100ms average response
Uptime Target: 99.9% availability
Scalability: Auto-scaling for traffic spikes
CDN Performance: Global content delivery
Monitoring: Real-time performance tracking
Error Rates: < 0.1% error rate target
```

## 🚀 INTEGRATION REQUIREMENTS

### External Integrations
```yaml
AIDE Repository:
  - Source: https://github.com/dragoscv/AIDE
  - Target: https://github.com/codai-ecosystem/AIDE
  - Integration: Git subtree to aide.codai.ro

StudiAI Repository:
  - Source: https://github.com/dragoscv/cursuri
  - Target: https://github.com/codai-ecosystem/studiai
  - Integration: Base platform for studiai.ro

Memorai MCP:
  - Source: https://github.com/dragoscv/memorai-mcp
  - Target: Integrated into memorai.ro
  - Features: Local + cloud MCP server
```

### Cross-Service Dependencies
```yaml
Authentication Flow:
  logai.ro → All Services (Universal SSO)
  
Memory & Storage:
  memorai.ro → All Services (Persistent memory)
  stocai.ro → All Services (File storage)
  
Financial Services:
  bancai.ro → wallet.bancai.ro, x.codai.ro
  wallet.bancai.ro → All Commerce Services
  
Analytics:
  analizai.ro → All Services (Data collection)
  dash.codai.ro → All Services (Visualization)
  
Identity & Reputation:
  id.codai.ro → All Services (Trust scoring)
  kodex.codai.ro → All Services (Governance)
```
